import hashlib,itertools,json,math,os,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
started=time.monotonic();source=Path(__file__).read_bytes();input_path=Path(sys.argv[1]);raw=input_path.read_bytes();cap=json.loads(raw)
expected='bd4d5e1d0e9fcfadef72cc9dba2cc4f7e6efacc6a577ee331fcd5b82574e5e49';assert cap['capsule']['source_sha256']==expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='centre-stat-frozen-') as directory:
    replay=Path(directory)
    for name,text in cap['capsule']['source_bytes_at_IMPORT'].items():
        assert Path(name).name==name and hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==cap['capsule']['source_sha256_at_IMPORT'][name]
        (replay/name).write_text(text)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(replay))
    import covariant_root_transfer as root
    from covariant_induced_photon import Parameters,phi_frame
    model=root.BosonicEdgeModel(8,((0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(0,4),(4,5),(4,6),(4,7),(1,5)))
    masks=sum((np.rint(np.diag(model.n(i)).real).astype(int)*(1<<i) for i in range(4)),np.zeros(model.dimension,dtype=int))
    Xstar=root.tensor_pauli(['X' if edge in ((0,1),(0,2),(0,3)) else 'I' for edge in model.edges])
    matrixunits={}
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(4),repeat=2):
        one=np.zeros((4,4),complex);one[i,j]=1;matrixunits[i,j]=root.native_lift(model,one)
    graph={m:[] for m in range(16)};pattern_error=0.
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(4),repeat=2):
        actual=Xstar@matrixunits[i,j].conj()@Xstar
        target=(model.identity if i==j else 0)-matrixunits[j,i]
        pattern_error=max(pattern_error,float(np.linalg.norm((abs(actual)>1e-10).astype(int)-(abs(target)>1e-10).astype(int))))
        for row,col in np.argwhere(abs(actual)>1e-10):
            ratio=target[row,col]/actual[row,col]
            graph[int(masks[col])].append((int(masks[row]),ratio))
    assert pattern_error==0
    phase={};consistency=0.
    for seed in range(16):
        if seed in phase:continue
        phase[seed]=1.+0j;queue=[seed]
        while queue:
            old=queue.pop()
            for new,ratio in graph[old]:
                desired=ratio*phase[old]
                if new in phase:consistency=max(consistency,abs(phase[new]-desired))
                else:phase[new]=desired;queue.append(new)
    assert consistency<1e-12
    C0=np.diag([phase[int(m)] for m in masks])@Xstar
    PH_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(C0@matrixunits[i,j].conj()@C0.conj().T-((model.identity if i==j else 0)-matrixunits[j,i]))) for i,j in matrixunits)
    gamma,_=phi_frame(Parameters());_,basis=np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0]);frame=np.column_stack((basis[:,2:],basis[:,:2]))
    Rb=frame.conj().T@(-1j*gamma[1]@gamma[2]@gamma[3])@frame
    values,vectors=np.linalg.eigh(Rb);minus=vectors[:,values<0];Pminus=minus@minus.conj().T
    GR=expm(1j*math.pi*root.native_lift(model,Pminus));C=GR@C0
    active=sum((model.n(i) for i in range(4)),np.zeros_like(model.identity))
    reference=sum((model.n(i) for i in range(4,8)),np.zeros_like(model.identity))
    N_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@active.conj()@C.conj().T-(4*model.identity-active)))
    Ref_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@reference.conj()@C.conj().T-reference))
    external=[]
    for edge_index,edge in enumerate(model.edges):
        if edge in ((0,1),(0,2),(0,3)):continue
        word=['I']*len(model.edges);word[edge_index]='Z';Z=root.tensor_pauli(word)
        external.append(dict(edge=edge,actual_C_Z_Cdag_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@Z.conj()@C.conj().T-Z))))
    S=model.stabilizers[0];S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@S.conj()@C.conj().T-S));S_flip=float(np.linalg.norm(C@S.conj()@C.conj().T+S))
    assert PH_error<1e-11 and N_error<1e-11 and Ref_error<1e-11 and max(row['actual_C_Z_Cdag_error'] for row in external)<1e-11
    result=dict(source_bytes=source.decode(),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
        input=dict(path=str(input_path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),frozen_root_sha256=expected),
        runtime=dict(executable=sys.executable,python=sys.version,numpy=np.__version__),native_full_dimension=model.dimension,
        primitive_onsite_PH_antiCAR_matrixunit_error=PH_error,onsite_phase_consistency_error=consistency,
        actual_phase_table={str(k):dict(real=v.real,imag=v.imag) for k,v in phase.items()},
        active_number_complement_error=N_error,Ref_number_fixed_error=Ref_error,all_external_Z_controls=external,
        actual_statistical_stabilizer_C_invariance_error=S_error,actual_statistical_stabilizer_C_flip_error=S_flip,
        support_proof='C0=occupation-diagonal phase times X on the three onsite star edges, followed by coefficient conjugation. Gamma(R) uses actual onsite even matrix units. All X/Y support is onsite; external incident factors are Z. Therefore EVERY spatial Z_e commutes with its unitary part and coefficient K fixes real Z_e. The native root chord and reference edges are explicitly checked.',
        connection_and_centre='For written D=Q^-1 dQ, C_D=Q^-1 Cstar Q gives D C_D=C_D D by trivialization. Four-mode PH gives centre phase z^-(4-N)z^-N=z^-4=1 per species. This is ideal pure-gauge connection descent; full outside law is not certified.',
        scope='Actual primitive 8-edge/256-dimensional Ref4 neutral representation and Dstat edge algebra. Do not infer all lattice statistical stabilizers from only one native cycle; its exact phase outcome is reported, not hidden. No new state, projection or physical Hamiltonian modification.',
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(output=sys.argv[2],source_sha256=result['source_sha256'],PH_error=PH_error,
        external_Z_error=max(row['actual_C_Z_Cdag_error'] for row in external),S_preserved_error=S_error,S_flipped_error=S_flip,
        elapsed_seconds=result['elapsed_seconds'])))
    print('Natural exit: actual onsite primitive antiCAR, Ref4 and spatial Dstat conjugation')
